simulation.engine: BitmaskGenerationSolver, stepped synchronously on the main thread

paths.note: The buffer's fill rate after the switch to the buffered path is scripted; the 100-generation lead it settles at is the game's cap. bytesPerDeltaCell is one Vector3Int in a born/died list.

strip.note: Frame pixels, y down from the top; slot s is centred at x = left + (s + 0.5) * slotPitch.
